deny.toml.content:
# cargo-deny policy. Checked by .github/workflows/cargo-deny.yml.
# Shared across the pantheon-* tool repositories; keep the copies in step.

[graph]
all-features = true

[advisories]
# Fail on any RustSec advisory (vulnerability, unmaintained, unsound) and on
# yanked releases. To accept one deliberately, add its id to `ignore` with a reason.
yanked = "deny"
# RUSTSEC-2024-0449: unsafe-libyaml is archived, with no fix. It arrives through
# serde_yaml_ng, which every tool uses to read frontmatter. Revisit when
# serde_yaml_ng moves to a maintained YAML backend; remove this entry then.
ignore = ["RUSTSEC-2024-0449"]

[licenses]
allow = [
    "MIT",
    "Apache-2.0",
    "Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception",
    "BSD-2-Clause",
    "BSD-3-Clause",
    "ISC",
    "Unicode-3.0",
    "Zlib",
    "CC0-1.0",
    "MPL-2.0",
    "MIT-0",
    "CDLA-Permissive-2.0",
]
confidence-threshold = 0.9
# The list is shared across repositories, so not every entry is used in each.
unused-allowed-license = "allow"

[bans]
multiple-versions = "warn"
wildcards = "deny"
# Path dependencies inside the workspace have no version requirement.
allow-wildcard-paths = true

[sources]
unknown-registry = "deny"
unknown-git = "deny"
allow-registry = ["https://github.com/rust-lang/crates.io-index"]
# The shared dev-kit is a git dependency until it is published to crates.io.
unused-allowed-source = "allow"
allow-git = ["https://github.com/pantheon-org/pantheon-agentic-harness-dev-kit"]

.github/workflows/cargo-deny.yml.content:
name: Cargo Deny

# Checks the dependency tree against deny.toml: RustSec advisories (including
# yanked and unmaintained crates), licences, banned or duplicate crates, and
# allowed registries and git sources. The advisory database changes without a
# commit here, so a weekly run catches new advisories on an idle repository.
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    branches: [main]
  push:
    branches: [main]
  schedule:
    - cron: "17 5 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  cargo-deny:
    name: Cargo Deny
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Install Rust toolchain
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install 1.96.1 --profile minimal
          rustup default 1.96.1

      - name: Check dependencies
        run: bash .github/scripts/cargo-deny.sh

.github/scripts/cargo-deny.sh.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# cargo-deny.sh
#
# Runs `cargo deny check` (advisories, licenses, bans, sources) against the
# policy in deny.toml, installing the pinned cargo-deny release first if needed.
# Duplicate crate versions only warn; every other finding fails the run.
#
# Usage: cargo-deny.sh [extra cargo-deny check arguments]
# Env:   CARGO_DENY_VERSION  override the pinned version

set -euo pipefail

VERSION="${CARGO_DENY_VERSION:-0.20.2}"

if ! command -v cargo-deny >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! cargo-deny --version | grep -q " ${VERSION}\$"; then
  cargo install cargo-deny --version "${VERSION}" --locked
fi

cargo deny --locked check "$@"
